# Marian Cozma — mcozma

> Product Design Lead. Shaping products, from direction to delivery.

Marian Cozma is a Product Design Lead with an engineering background and experience across banking, telco and technology. Work spans enterprise platforms, customer journeys and team leadership. Public previews link to full case studies available after approval; reported results distinguish research findings from post-launch outcomes.

## Public portfolio

- [Marian Cozma — Product Design Lead | mcozma](https://mcozma.com/): Marian Cozma (mrcozma), Product Design Lead with 10+ years across banking, telco and technology. Explore design work, leadership experience and mentorship.
- [Product Design Portfolio — Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/work/): Explore Marian Cozma’s design work for Google, Three, UBS, Legal & General and more, across technology, financial services and digital commerce.
- [About Marian Cozma — Design Leadership & Experience](https://mcozma.com/about/): From front-end engineering to design leadership: Marian Cozma brings over 10 years of experience simplifying complex products and helping design teams grow.
- [Lab — Independent Projects & Resources | Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/lab/): Explore Decised, AVENTROPY, Wider Insights and practical design resources shared by Marian Cozma on Figma Community.
- [Contact Marian Cozma — Product Design & Collaboration](https://mcozma.com/contact/): Talk with Marian Cozma about a product design opportunity, a client project through AVENTROPY or a new challenge. Book a conversation or get in touch by email.
- [Google — Component Systems & Interaction Design | Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/project-google/): A preview of Marian Cozma’s work on configurable components and interaction rules at Google, developed with product and engineering through design delivery.
- [Three UK — Connected Digital Experiences | Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/project-three/): Explore Marian Cozma’s contribution to customer journeys and reusable page structures at Three UK, connecting research, responsive design and platform delivery.
- [UBS — Research & Workflow Design | Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/project-ubs/): A preview of Marian Cozma’s research, workflow design and user testing for an operational platform at UBS, helping people understand priorities and act.
- [Legal & General — Responsive Content Design | Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/project-legal-and-general/): Explore Marian Cozma’s reusable content-tile design for Legal & General, connecting account tasks, customer control, responsive components and validation.
- [JLR — Range Rover Digital Sales Concept | Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/project-jlr/): Explore Marian Cozma’s contribution at Tangity to a Range Rover digital sales concept, connecting research, stakeholder workshops and experience design.
- [Totaljobs — Recruiter Commerce Design | Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/project-totaljobs/): A preview of Marian Cozma’s interface design and hands-on front-end implementation for responsive recruiter commerce at Totaljobs.
- [Virgin Media — Guided Support Design | Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/project-virgin-media/): Explore Marian Cozma’s work on guided support at Virgin Media, connecting content, navigation and decision logic across web and mobile experiences.
- [Design Mentorship — Marian Cozma](https://mcozma.com/mentorship/): Practical design mentorship with Marian Cozma. Bring a portfolio, career question or live design challenge to a focused conversation.
